title: Zesty Sweet Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A pungent and silky Spanish dish featuring sugars and a deglaze, suitable for weeknights and diabetic-friendly diets
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the smoked paprika and saffron threads to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the uncooked white rice to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, and honey to the skillet and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 20 minutes
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until heated through
